recommended_actions: Use the story rubric deductions and suggestions to build a revision plan.

revision_suggestions: Strengthen the opening reveal or contradiction.
Clarify why each scene triggers the next escalation.
Align dialogue and actions with the character objective.
Add an explicit choice or refusal beat for the protagonist.
Sharpen the emotional turn between scenes.
Increase public, relational, or status consequences in later scenes.
Replace generic lines with concrete, high-stakes phrasing.
Tighten pacing and front-load the strongest beat.
Reduce ambiguous references and sharpen audience framing.
Strengthen episode-end curiosity and future payoff.
End on a sharper unanswered reveal or power reversal.
